source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title says Get Sensor Type, but Procedure performs both Get and Set and Criteria require successful setting. A dedicated adjacent Set case already exists. DeepSeek replaces all of this with a generic insecure sensor-info query. These are core operation and coverage contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The unresolved choice changes the test from read-only telemetry to a state-changing monitoring operation and determines what PASS means. This core semantic conflict cannot be treated as ordinary project readiness or guessed safely.

review_improvement: Makes the read/write contradiction, adjacent-case duplication, transport scope and security defects explicit and prevents either a hidden coverage reduction or an unauthorized sensor-type mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get Sensor Type 0x2f is a read-only observation; Set Sensor Type 0x2e changes how the BMC interprets telemetry and events. Combining them can be a legitimate write/readback test, but that intent conflicts with this title and duplicates the preceding dedicated Set case. Because selecting one interpretation changes both blast radius and acceptance evidence, only engineering ownership can resolve the record; a generic sensor-info command cannot do so.
